SELECT category, 
       ((SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM created_at) = 2 THEN amount_idr ELSE 0 END) -
         SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM created_at) = 1 THEN amount_idr ELSE 0 END)) /
        SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM created_at) = 1 THEN amount_idr ELSE 0 END)) * 100 AS growth_rate
FROM transactions
JOIN merchants ON transactions.merchant_id = merchants.merchant_id
WHERE created_at BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-12-31'

ORDER BY growth_rate ASC

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id)
FROM transactions
WHERE status = 'success'
  AND created_at >= '2026-08-01'
  AND created_at < '2026-09-01'
  AND merchant_id IN (
    SELECT merchant_id
    FROM transactions
    WHERE status = 'success'
      AND created_at >= '2026-08-01'
      AND created_at < '2026-09-01'
    GROUP BY merchant_id
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT merchant_id) >= 3

SELECT 
  (SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t.created_at) = 2025 THEN t.amount_idr ELSE 0 END) -
   SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t.created_at) = 2024 THEN t.amount_idr ELSE 0 END)) /
  SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t.created_at) = 2024 THEN t.amount_idr ELSE 0 END) * 100 AS yoy_growth
FROM transactions t
WHERE t.created_at BETWEEN '2025-09-01' AND '2025-09-30'

SELECT m.category,

FROM merchants m
JOIN transactions t ON m.merchant_id = t.merchant_id
LEFT JOIN refunds r ON t.txn_id = r.txn_id
WHERE t.created_at >= '2026-07-01' AND t.created_at < '2026-10-01'
GROUP BY m.category
ORDER BY refund_rate DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT SUM(t.amount_idr) - SUM(s.gross_idr)
FROM transactions t
JOIN settlements s ON t.merchant_id = s.merchant_id AND t.created_at::date = s.settle_date
WHERE t.created_at::date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30'
  AND s.settle_date = '2026-09-30'

SELECT date
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT DATE_TRUNC('day', created_at) AS date
  FROM transactions
  WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', created_at) BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-12-31'
) AS daily_dates
WHERE date NOT IN (
  SELECT DISTINCT DATE_TRUNC('day', created_at)
  FROM transactions
  WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', created_at) BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-12-31'
    AND (amount_idr - discount_idr) * mdr_rate < 0.85
)
